datasets.name: AgentDojo recorded runs (labelled attacks: attacker goal reached)
datasets.flag_meaning: security=true means the injected task goal was achieved (verified by reading tool calls); those runs are the labelled set.

taint.method: approximated from the record by shared substrings
taint.note: tainted_by edges link a step to earlier outputs in the same session sharing a verbatim run of >= 20 characters with its arguments; source class is of the earlier output (web, mcp, file, test output, user). This is NOT Nodwyn value-level taint.
